metadata.title: Your account
metadata.description: Sign in to follow players and clubs, mark yourself and the tournaments you play, and vote on what Elodrop does next.

signIn.intro: With an account you can follow players and clubs, mark which player is you, keep your tournaments in your calendar and vote on what comes next. The rankings and every page stay open to everyone.
signIn.codeSent: We sent a code to {email}. It works for an hour.
signIn.sendFailed: The code couldn't be sent. Check the address, or try again in a minute.
signIn.codeFailed: That code didn't work. Check it, or send a new one.

profile.title: Create your account
profile.nicknameHelp: 3–20 characters. It's shown with the ideas you suggest, never with your name or email.
profile.privacy: I've read <link>how Elodrop handles my data</link>.
profile.tooYoung: Accounts are for ages {age} and over, so none was made, and your sign-in has been deleted. A parent can follow your player page with their own account.

me.title: This is me
me.intro: Pick yourself among the players. Only you see it: it marks your player page and puts your rating on the front page.
me.label: You are
me.locked: You can choose someone else from {date}.
me.confirm: Are you {name}? Once you've chosen, you can't choose someone else for {days} days.
me.confirmClear: Remove {name} as you? You can't choose anyone again until {date}.

following.title: Following
following.description: You and the players you follow, with their ratings and how they moved last week.
following.empty: Follow players with the star on their page, and they show up here.
following.manage: The players and clubs you follow. Press the cross to stop following one.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.intro: Everything goes at once: your profile, follows, tournaments, votes and reports. Ideas you suggested stay, without your name.
danger.warning: This can't be undone. Your account and everything in it are deleted at once, and can't be brought back.

errors.too_young: Accounts are for ages 15 and over.
errors.nickname_blocked: That nickname can't be used. Try another.
errors.nickname_taken: That nickname is taken. Try another.
errors.claim_too_soon: You chose a player less than 30 days ago.
errors.account_too_new: Your account is too new for this yet.
errors.too_many_pending: You have 2 ideas waiting to be looked at already.
errors.reports_off: Reports are switched off for now.
errors.reports_blocked: You can't send reports any more.
errors.not_your_player: You can only report mistakes about yourself, 14 days after choosing who you are.
errors.report_open: You have a report waiting already.
errors.too_many_reports: You've sent 3 reports in the last 90 days.
errors.player_reported: This player has reports waiting already.

report.title: Report a mistake
report.intro: Something wrong on your page? Tell us what, and it's checked by hand. You can send one at a time and 3 in 90 days.
report.noteHelp: Up to 280 characters. Don't write anything about others.
report.sent: Thanks. It will be checked by hand, and you can follow it on your account page.
report.declinedNote: A second declined report ends reporting for your account.

ideas.title: Ideas
ideas.description: What could Elodrop do next? Vote for the ideas you want, or suggest one.
ideas.intro: What could Elodrop do next? Vote for the ideas you'd use. The most wanted come first, and the ones being worked on are marked.
ideas.signIn: <link>Sign in</link> to vote and suggest ideas.

suggest.title: Suggest an idea
suggest.intro: Ideas are read before they're shown, with your nickname. You can have 2 waiting at a time.
suggest.name: The idea, in a line
suggest.sent: Thanks! It's shown once it has been read.
suggest.tooNew: Accounts can suggest ideas from 7 days after they're made.
suggest.contact: Elodrop may email me about this idea
suggest.contactHelp: To ask about it or talk it through. Your email address is never shown to anyone.

overview.noClaim: Pick yourself among the players, and your numbers show up here: your next tournament, your recent weeks, each season and your career.

next.title: Your next tournament
next.note: Your chance against each from your ratings now. Draw luck: above zero your draw helps, below it hurts, against a fair draw (as on the tournament page).

season.title: Season in review
season.underdogHelp: Matches you had under a 50 % chance of winning
season.deciderHelp: Matches that went to a third set

career.title: Career and form
career.nemesisHelp: The opponents you've lost to most (at least 3 losses)
